```plato

    //==
    // # Stepping a system
    //
    // Emission is deliberately absent. Spawning from a `ParticleEmitter*`
    // means drawing from the Speed / Lifetime / Size ranges it declares, which
    // needs a random stream threaded through the step and returned from it —
    // a different piece of work with its own state design. Everything below
    // steps the particles that already exist, which is what a simulation of a
    // fixed population (and every cloth) needs.

    // Every particle of a set advanced one step under a force set, with the
    // clock read in seconds.
    StepParticles(particles: Array<Particle3D>, forces: ParticleForces3D, time: Number, dt: Duration): Array<Particle3D>
        => particles.Map(p => p.Step(forces.AccelerationAt(p.Position, p.Velocity, time), dt));
```
